MECA.TITLE: Card Left Prevention Buzzer ON/OFF Setting Function

ITEM.PTXT: While the vehicle is stopped (with ACC or IG ON and the ETC card inserted), each time the usage history check button and the volume switch "Up" are pressed simultaneously for 2 seconds or more, the card left warning is switched between enabled and disabled. The card left warning can also be enabled/disabled in the ETC settings using the HDD navigation system.
